item.title: VNtyper 2
item.description: Abstract Background: ADTKD-MUC1 is one of the major entities of ADTKD caused by frameshift variants in the MUC1 VNTR that standard short-read sequencing fails to detect. Existing 59dupC-targeted probe-extension assays do not allow for broad screening and cannot detect atypical non-dupC variants. Recently, VNtyper, a Kestrel-based genotyping pipeline with optional code-adVNTR cross-validation for MUC1 VNTR genotyping from short-read sequencing data allowed to circumvent this diagnostic limitation, but needed further development for easy access and rapid sample processing.
